description: Fetch any public web page and return its main content as clean Markdown (navigation, scripts and boilerplate removed) with title, description, language, canonical URL, author, publish date, headings, links and images. Built for agents that need to read or cite the web. Follows up to 5 redirects; HTML, plain text and JSON pages. Price: 0.005 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. Free sample answer: get_example {"tool":"web_extract"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/extract?url=https%3A%2F%2Fen.wikipedia.org%2Fwiki%2FHTTP_402

links.description: 1 to include every link on the page (default 1)
